items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: like the Nick Toshes, like the Peter Guralnicks, to really show — now my mentor was doing it.

ctx.x: I mean that’s pretty ridiculous, isn’t it.

Of course. And it’s nasty thinking number one, and it’s limited thinking number two. And one of the things I’ve tried to show in our world is that, you know I told the class, now we’re going to go to country and folk. Now for many of you, you’re from the northeast, and you’re going to think this stuff is not so great. But I want to show you some really great artists, and today they are treated that way. But they weren’t during their lifetime. And it took a while for some of the younger historians to come in, like…
And I’m fascinated by the — you had one chart, it was almost like a poster, and it said King Records. It was a thing for King Records.
